comparison_semantics: Numerical equivalence across declared runtimes. This is neither byte identity nor a scientific uncertainty budget. JSON structure, status, booleans and text are exact; only the three declared runtime-version values are ignored, and numeric values use the explicit replay tolerances.
scientific_status_guard: The scan remains Level A only inside each supplied calibrated action/state and Level C as a completion scan; it is not a fit, not a unique ECT prediction and not evidence that the still-Open physical completion has been selected.
